notes: Governmental funds modified cash basis (statements p3-p4); business-type activities accrual basis, so business_type measure is net position from the proprietary statement p6 and the proprietary cash flows (p7) are recorded (as FY2023-FY2025). Governmental roll-forward uses fund balances (p4): Debt Service 'Net proceeds/(uses) of long-term debt' 360,000 printed under other financing sources -> debt_proceeds; transfers summed from fund columns (Total column prints net -). ending_cash = governmental funds Cash and cash equivalents 997,410 (p3), ending_investments = Certificates of deposit 130,818; Cash at county treasurer 10,064 (p3) printed separately and not added. Beginning cash not printed. Business-type receipts total = total operating revenues 562,248 (no nonoperating revenues); disbursements = operating expenses + interest expense from p6 (the Statement of Activities prints 536,936, a 1 rounding difference, see report_discrepancies). Proprietary 'Other revenue' 8,291 is counted as Miscellaneous general revenue on the Statement of Activities, so it stays other. Statement capital outlay spans several funds, so it keeps the plain label; General Fund capital outlay has no printed function. Detail: four governmental budgetary comparison schedules (pp8-11); the nonmajor Other fund and the proprietary funds have no schedule and are not added (as FY2023/FY2024). Budget '-' recorded as 0.
